Class MainController

java.lang.Object
com.robuschi.MainController
public class MainController extends Object

The MainController class serves as a controller for the main application view.

Handles product management operations and the interaction with the GUI.

  • Method Details

    • setApplication

      public void setApplication(ProductClient application)

      Sets the main application reference.

      It is called in the ProductClient class when the main view is shown through the mainController.setApplication(this) method.

      It calls the requestProductList() method to show the products in their respective lists.

      Parameters:
      application - the main application

    • setUserLabel

      public void setUserLabel(String usrLbl)

      This method sets the label in the top of the main view, making it so that it displays the username.

      It is called in the ProductClient class immediately after the user successfully logs in.

      Parameters:
      usrLbl - is the string that contains the username of the logged user

    • initialize

      private void initialize()

      Initializes the controller.

      Called automatically by JavaFX.

    • handlePurchase

      private void handlePurchase()

      This method handles the purchase button action.

      If a product in the product list is selected it sends a message of type PURCHASE_PRODUCT and the selected product as payload to the server.

    • handleReturn

      private void handleReturn()

      This method handles return button action.

      If a product in the user's product list is selected it sends a message of type PRODUCT_RETURN and the selected product as payload to the server.

    • handleAddProduct

      private void handleAddProduct()

      This method handles add product button action.

      It creates a dialog window with the CSS style of the other dialogs, then checks the validity of the data inserted by the user [for example if one of the two text fields (the product name or the product price) is empty].

      If the data inserted is correct it sends a message of type ADD_NEW_PRODUCT and the inserted product as payload to the server.

      Lastly it calls the requestProductList() method to update the products in their respective lists.

    • handleLogout

      private void handleLogout()

      Handles logout button action by calling the application.logout() method.

      The application in this case is an instance of the ProductClient class.
